67.overview:

When Sally hears noises and sees a shape at the window, she worries Mick's escaped. Then, as a ghostly figure appears behind her, Sally hits them with a vase,

67.name: Friday, 30th October 2026
67.overview: When Lucy shows Christina family videos, Christina spots Richie being abusive to Rachel. Later, Lucy asks Christina why she has a photo of her mum on her key ring. In the precinct, Daniel and Amy hand out flyers to raise awareness about the Weathy High land grab. Meanwhile, Ken urges Daniel to write about it in The Gazette.

67.name: Monday, 2nd November 2026
67.overview: Eavesdropping Idris hears Carla talking to Lisa about a critical meeting concerning the factory. Then, as the client heads to the loo, Idris stops him for a chat. What's his plan? In his prison cell, Gary notices a gash on Marco's arm and is worried he's being bullied. Summer's upset when Marco refuses to come out for her visit.

67.name: Tuesday, 3rd November 2026
67.overview: After Carla tells her devastated staff she's struggling to keep Underworld afloat, Idris gives Brody a job. Brody steals Sally's keys and lets himself into the factory... A furious Daniel confronts Adam about his involvement with Idris and the pair end up fighting in the street. Will Adam make it to court for Marco's appeal hearing?

67.name: Wednesday, 4th November 2026
67.overview: When fragile Kit arrives home to hear Gemma and Bernie discussing the BRCA gene again, he feels smothered, so Dev takes him out for curry and a pep talk. At Speed Daal, Leanne tells Idris and Brody she saw Brody breaking into the factory. Meanwhile, Carla's workers learn she has to shut down the business.

67.overview: Debbie tells Ronnie that they need to discuss her long-term care while she's still able to make decisions, but her husband is too heartbroken to even think about it. An exhausted Kit refuses to go home from work but loses his temper when someone coughs near him. He's annoyed when Lisa says he must go on sick leave.
